breaking.change: Vector authoring now consumes checked TS declarations directly. The OGT vector parser, intermediate VectorFile and sibling-path lookup are deleted. SVG tessellation and the cooked/runtime vector representation are unchanged; explicit source bytes are captured before cook cache lookup.
breaking.fix: Export file.vector({source:'assets/ui/emblem.svg',tolerance:0.05}) or file.vector({svg:'<svg ...>...</svg>'}) from content/<name>.ts, importing file from @origingame/engine/author. Source paths are canonical and relative to the owning module. Load <module>/<content-relative-stem> with og.load.vector instead of an .ogt path. See og api show file:vector.
